tweet.text:
We reviewed the “Risks from automated R&D” section of Anthropic’s August 2026 Risk Report, with access to the nonpublic version.

We focus on the report’s claims about catastrophic risks from automated AI R&D and about whether Anthropic had crossed relevant capability thresholds.
